newsitem.title: USA: Connective Therapeutics signs credit pact.
newsitem.headline: Connective Therapeutics signs credit pact.

text.p: Connective Therapeutics Inc on Friday said it has signed an agreement with an unnamed investment group giving the company a $25 million credit line based on sales of its common stock.
The equity credit line, called a Structured Equity Line Flexible (SELF) financing agreement, will be available for three years starting in 1997's fourth quarter.
"This is a very innovative and attractive financing vehicle for the company," said Cynthia Butitta, chief financial officer.

Under the agreement, Connective Therapeutics can obtain $500,000 to $2 million each time it draws on the credit line through a sale of company common, subject to minimum price and volume requirements.

Connective must sell $500,000 of common stock on a quarterly basis if its stock price exceeds certain levels. Should Connective draw from the equity line, shares will be priced at 93 percent of the common stock's average trading price over a specified period of time.
As a commitment fee, the company has issued a five year warrant for 250,000 common shares to the investment group.
